title: Identity-related Speech Suppression in Generative AI Content Moderation

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating speech suppression scores by comparing the false positive rates (or median moderation scores) of automated content moderation APIs on benign text referencing men or women (tagged via keywords and external dataset associations) against the overall false positive rate.

Calculating speech suppression scores by comparing the false positive rates (or median moderation scores) of automated content moderation APIs on benign text referencing Christian or non-Christian identities against the overall false positive rate.

Calculating speech suppression scores by comparing the false positive rates (or median moderation scores) of automated content moderation APIs on benign text referencing LGBT or straight identities against the overall false positive rate.

Calculating speech suppression scores by comparing the false positive rates (or median moderation scores) of automated content moderation APIs on benign text referencing white or non-white identities against the overall false positive rate.

Calculating speech suppression scores by comparing the false positive rates (or median moderation scores) of automated content moderation APIs on benign text referencing disabilities against the overall false positive rate.
